resolution.note: Three paths to close the funding gap. One is recommended.
resolution.note2: These options are not mutually exclusive. The recommended path pairs the education-community deposit campaign with a standby funding line to close the gap now and hold a buffer through Q1.

options.title: Education-community deposit campaign
options.desc: Targeted share-gathering across the education field of membership and the newly merged Howard University members, timed to land ahead of the fall payroll-cycle inflow window.

options.title: Standby funding line
options.desc: A committed facility held in reserve. Immediate certainty and a hard buffer, but it is purchased liquidity and it does not move the underlying trend.

options.title: Campaign paired with a standby line
options.desc: The campaign moves the trend while the line holds the buffer through Q1 in case uptake lands at the low edge of the seasonality band.

closing.signoff: The position is strong. The trend is the thing to manage — and now you can see it, prove it, and act on it in the same session.

steps.title: Launch the education-community deposit campaign
steps.body: Marketing & Member Growth own the campaign with Finance & ALM. It is scoped to the education field of membership and the Howard University division and sequenced to land ahead of the fall payroll-cycle inflow window, not after the summer draw. Approval is the near-term ask; the campaign itself lands in August so it arrives ahead of the September inflow rather than being spent before the summer draw.

steps.title: Arrange the standby funding line
steps.body: Finance & ALM bring the facility to the Board Finance Committee as the buffer behind the campaign, sized to the shortfall in the pessimistic seasonality case rather than the modeled one. This is purchased liquidity: it buys certainty, not trend — which is why it is paired with the campaign rather than chosen instead of it.

steps.title: Close the Howard University division reconciliation
steps.body: Data Governance and Technology restore the stalled nightly mapping, close the $2.7M share and 490-member gap, and confirm the consolidated figures. Until it closes, the board sees the enterprise figure with the division shown separately — flagged, never smoothed.
